The '''Jedd system''' was located in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The sixth [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] position in the [[Star system/Legends|system]] was occupied by the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Jedd Six]]. During the last [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]],<ref name="CSWE" /> the [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="GG2">''[[Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin]]''</ref> [[Lexi Fernandin]] became the first individual to [[Scout/Legends|scout]] the planet.<ref name="CSWE" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Jedd system was first mentioned in "[[Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star, How I Wonder Where We Are]]," a [[1990]] [[roleplaying game]] source article written by [[Glen Allison]] as a supplement for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' and published in [[Voyages SF 13|''Voyages SF'' 13]]. The article placed it in the [[Grehollo sector]].<ref name="Twinkle">{{VoyagesCite|13|Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star, How I Wonder Where We Are}}</ref> Since that article was released outside of the [[Lucas Licensing]] process,<ref name="Twinkle" /> it is considered non-[[canon]]ical with respect to the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="UnlicensedStatus">{{UnlicensedStatus}}</ref> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Jedd system in grid square I-14.<ref name="EAOC" />
